results.title: [SYNTHETIC] AcmeCRM vs ZenFlow
results.text:
## AcmeCRM vs ZenFlow

ZenFlow Pro costs $75 per seat. AcmeCRM Pro costs $90 per seat.
Legacy page. Pro plan was $70 per user per month until 2025.
